# Text.Split

```m
Text.Split(text as text, separator as text) as list
```

Splits text into a list of text values based upon a specified delimiter.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/text-split)
